class.name: eiriarm_controllers/DMHardwareInterface
class.description: Direct ros2_control SystemInterface for DM motors over usb2can. Subscribes /motor/chN/state, publishes /motor/chN/cmd and /motor/chN/motor_enable. Performs raw to URDF conversion (zero offset, axis sign, single-turn wrap correction) inside the interface so that controllers and ros2_control consumers always see joint values in the URDF frame. Exports MIT-mode command interfaces per joint: position, velocity, effort (feed-forward torque), stiffness (kp), damping (kd). Controllers may write any subset; unclaimed commands stay at 0. State interfaces per joint: position, velocity, effort (URDF frame).
